findings.same_referent_reason: Contextually refers to the completion date of the inquiry report. Page 1 cites the report date as 9 November 2563, and physical image inspection confirms the handwritten date on Page 2 is '๙'.
findings.ocr_reason: Typhoon OCR misread the handwritten Thai numeral '๙' (9) on Page 2 as two digits '๑๕' (15). This creates an impossible chronological inversion where the internal report is dated 15 November, post-dating both the Superintendent approval (10 November) and the prosecutor submission letter (11 November).
